description: This file defines the class MatrixPaletteRenderer, which implements a GLSurfaceView.Renderer for rendering a textured 3D grid with matrix palette skinning in an OpenGL ES context, including grid data setup, texture loading, and rendering logic.

classes.name: MatrixPaletteRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for displaying a textured animated grid with matrix palette skinning in OpenGL ES.

classes.name: Grid
classes.description: A helper class that manages a rectangular grid of vertices, their associated buffers, and rendering via VBOs using OpenGL ES, tailored for this particular rendering example.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL context, loads texture, and sets up grid data.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Per-frame rendering logic, including clearing buffers, setting up matrices, applying transformations, and drawing the grid.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles viewport and projection matrix adjustment upon surface size change.

methods.name: generateWeightedGrid
methods.description: Creates a grid object with vertex data representing a cylindrical shape, including texture coordinates and weights.
